meta.title: OpenPI: delegate a task, observe it, receive the result
meta.subtitle: Direct subagent path · separate Pi session, same process · source pinned to 677b495

components.label: Parent Pi agent
components.explanation: The caller is the parent model using registered Pi tools, not an HTTP task endpoint. subagent_spawn accepts a prompt and name plus optional working directory, role, model, reasoning effort, worktree isolation and output schema. It returns a child ID after startup; it does not wait for the task's answer. The parent owns delegation strategy and synthesis.

components.label: Subagent tool boundary
components.explanation: index.ts registers subagent_spawn, subagent_check, subagent_list and subagent_wait. Spawn validates cwd; resolves trust, role, model and inherited thinking; intersects the parent's active tools with the requested child capabilities; and optionally creates a worktree, failing rather than silently falling back. Async handlers execute manager effects through a shared ManagedRuntime. check/list read snapshots without waiting; wait tracks explicit interest, waits for settlement and consumes deferred automatic delivery. Aborting wait leaves children running.

components.label: Subagent manager
components.explanation: The Effect service reserves a concurrency slot before asynchronous startup, optionally acquires shared child-execution admission, chooses the backend, owns a child scope and allocates sa-N. A scoped event pump folds streaming text, tools and terminal outcomes into an in-memory snapshot. Settlement records done/completed or error/failed/interrupted, final text, generation and evidence; notifies readers/waiters; and invokes onSettled with whether a wait is collecting the result. Snapshots are the live status read model, not a durable task queue.

sources.label: Admission, child scope and event pump

components.label: Pi adapter + child session
components.explanation: The sole production backend creates a separate AgentSession with SessionManager.create(cwd), trust-gated resources and childToolPolicy. It subscribes to Pi events, calls session.prompt(task.prompt) without waiting for task completion, and converts activity and completion into normalized manager events. A terminal result waits for the exact prompt promise to settle; missing lifecycle evidence becomes failure. Independence is conversational and lifecycle ownership within the same process, not an OS sandbox. The working directory is shared unless worktree isolation was explicitly requested.

components.label: Completion delivery
components.explanation: onSettled records a parent transcript finish entry. If an explicit wait already owns the result, automatic delivery is consumed. Otherwise it defers a snapshot copy into the shared completion inbox. If the parent is idle, delivery flushes immediately; otherwise the next parent agent_settled event flushes the batch. Claim/ack/consume prevents duplicate collection between wait and follow-up; synchronous dispatch failure retries the batch. The dispatcher appends a result entry and sends subagent-result with deliverAs: followUp and triggerTurn: true, so the parent need not receive another user prompt.

sources.label: Inbox claim, consume, retry and flush
Append result and trigger parent turn

components.label: Parent Pi transcript
components.sublabel: Finish + result entries via Pi API
components.explanation: OpenPI calls pi.appendEntry for subagent-finished (status, completion and evidence binding) and, on the automatic dispatch path, subagent-result (content and result details). This node denotes Pi's session transcript API, not an independently evidenced database service. The checked-out adapter does not establish physical session-write durability; a failed finish append marks evidence parentBound false rather than changing execution success.

boundaries.label: OpenPI subagent runtime · in the parent process
Separate session · restricted tools, not an OS sandbox

cards.title: Accept → execute → observe
items: Spawn returns sa-N after startup, not the answer. Manager snapshots expose running, done or error plus final text and completion evidence.
check/list are nonblocking. Explicit wait returns settled output; otherwise completion wakes the parent automatically.
The parent decides task decomposition and synthesis. No fixed planner or external worker service is required by this path.

cards.title: Important boundaries
items: Child tools are a fail-closed intersection of parent authority and role/plan restrictions (shared/child-session.ts:625–660).
Independent session ≠ isolated filesystem. Default cwd is shared; requested worktree creation must succeed (subagents/index.ts:1041–1089).
A stop timeout is execution-uncertain, not proof of quiescence; admission remains held (subagents/src/manager.ts:711–738).

cards.title: Scope and evidence limits
items: Overview of direct model-spawned subagents; /btw, workflow orchestration, UI takeover and standalone task tracking are outside this slice.
Pi SDK internals and provider transport are outside the selected implementation. SessionManager.create and appendEntry do not alone prove durable disk writes.
Execution outcome, result persistence and evidence are distinct. Optional structured output is schema-gated; saving its artifact can fail without changing execution success (backends/pi.ts:432–460).
